newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers all firm, nervous buyers rush in.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers all firm, nervous buyers rush in.

text.p: European bunkers all firmed on Thursday and buyers, nervous of further price rises, rushed in to buy at many ports, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST was up $3 a tonne at $127/$129 fob as firmer crude and French buying drew up barge prices. Certain supply problems added to the strength. One major in Rotterdam announced at the start of the week that it would not be offering. In Antwerp, another was running short of product.
"A number of buyers who would normally take in Antwerp simply came looking in the crowded Rotterdam market," said one dealer.
Enquiries throughout ARA also rose from a sluggish base on Wednesday. Hamburg bunkers were also up about $2 a tonne.
Bunkers in Mediterranean ports rose by $2/$3 a tonne and enquiries were plentiful, particularly in Spain which closes for a national holiday on Friday.
East Med and Middle East demand was also healthy, buyers there also believing prices were likely to rise further.
"The trend seems to be up until Christmas," one supplier said.
